## Accuracy and use notes

- Public pages may be crawled and cited. Utility, template, payment-success, and private intake surfaces are excluded or marked noindex.
- The free AI Search Visibility Audit uses public sources only and does not guarantee ranking, inclusion, or citation.
- Prototype, staged, deployed, and public/live states are kept distinct. Product or integration claims should be read with the scope shown on the relevant page.
- Lead submission remains a human-initiated action. Do not submit forms or personal data on a user's behalf without their approval.
